shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
animal or creature figures in profile
horizontal register band of repeated motifs
justification: Both are low-relief carved surfaces that use profile views and a horizontal band of repeated motifs with dense patterned infill, but the actual subjects differ entirely: A is a single large naturalistic human head in profile with elaborate curled beard, hair, earring and headdress filling the whole field, while B is a multi-register composition of small schematic animals (quadrupeds, a large bird, a fox-like creature) and rows of abstract signs. The only correspondences are generic to relief carving in general (profile orientation, banded registers), not a shared distinctive motif or relationship.
